title: Crispy Pork German Flatbread
description: A hearty German-inspired flatbread topped with crispy pork and fresh herbs.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt and black pepper.
Sear the pork in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pork to a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the pork is cooking, cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Transfer the cooked bacon to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess grease.
In the same skillet, cook the sliced onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the German mustard to the skillet and stir to combine.
Spread the onion and mustard mixture evenly over the flatbread.
Top the flatbread with the roasted pork, crispy bacon, and fresh parsley.
Return the flatbread to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
